def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
                color=grid[r][c]; q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx]==color:
                            seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
                comps.append((color,cells))
    anchors=[min(r for r,c in cells) for color,cells in comps if color==8]
    if not anchors: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    target=min(anchors)
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color,cells in comps:
        shift=target-min(r for r,c in cells)
        for r,c in cells: out[r+shift][c]=color
    return out
